enterDfu.title: Enter DFU mode
enterDfu.detail: Follow the guide for the Power and Home buttons and wait for the device to appear in DFU mode.

exploitBootrom.title: Exploit the bootrom (limera1n)
exploitBootrom.detail: Send the limera1n payload to the A4 chip to reach pwned DFU. Nothing is persisted.

fetchResources.title: Download firmware components and payload
fetchResources.detail: Fetch iBSS, iBEC, kernel and ramdisk from the iOS 6.1.6 firmware and verify their digests.

buildRamdisk.title: Build the SSH ramdisk
buildRamdisk.detail: Decrypt verified firmware components, patch iBSS / iBEC and build a ramdisk with SSH.

bootRamdisk.title: Boot the ramdisk
bootRamdisk.detail: Send the patched boot chain to the device and boot it. The screen stays black or shows progress.

mountFilesystem.title: Mount the device filesystem
mountFilesystem.detail: Mount the system partition read-only, verify its firmware and check for an existing jailbreak.

installUntether.title: Install the untether, Cydia and OpenSSH
installUntether.detail: Write the untether, Cydia and OpenSSH, checking every command result. This step cannot be cancelled.

rebootDevice.title: Reboot the device
rebootDevice.detail: Leave the ramdisk and boot normally. The first boot is slower than usual.

verifyJailbreak.title: Verify the jailbreak
verifyJailbreak.detail: Wait for the device to reappear and confirm Cydia and SSH are available.

dfuTimeout.title: DFU mode was not reached
dfuTimeout.body: No DFU device appeared within the waiting time. The device was not modified.
recovery: If the screen shows an Apple logo or the "connect to iTunes" screen, hold Power and Home for about 15 seconds to leave it.
Try another USB port or cable and avoid hubs.
Press Retry and follow the button guide again.

exploitFailed.title: limera1n exploit failed
exploitFailed.body: Preparation could not confirm pwned DFU. Successful enumeration in ordinary DFU does not prove the exploit succeeded. Check the failed stage and USB diagnostic below.
recovery: Review the failed stage and USB reason, and keep the operation log.
Before another attempt, reboot completely and re-enter DFU from a powered-off state.
Open and confirm a new preparation plan before starting again.

downloadFailed.title: Firmware download failed
downloadFailed.body: The required firmware components could not be fetched or failed verification. The device was not modified.
recovery: Check the network connection.
Retrying downloads and verifies the missing files again.

buildFailed.title: Ramdisk build failed
buildFailed.body: Patching did not complete. The device was not modified.
recovery: A new plan rebuilds the temporary ramdisk.
If it keeps failing, export the log and report it.

ramdiskBootFailed.title: Ramdisk boot failed
ramdiskBootFailed.body: The device did not boot the patched ramdisk.
recovery: Hold Power and Home for about 15 seconds to reboot the device.
Enter DFU mode again and retry the whole flow.

sshUnavailable.title: SSH connection failed
sshUnavailable.body: The ramdisk booted but the SSH service did not respond.
recovery: Wait 30 seconds and retry; the ramdisk sometimes needs longer.
Reboot the device and enter DFU mode again.

writeFailed.title: Writing the untether failed
writeFailed.body: The write was interrupted and the system partition may be inconsistent. Do not unplug the device yet.
recovery: Keep it connected and first try holding Power and Home for about 15 seconds to reboot.
If the device boots normally, run the whole flow again.
If it is stuck on the Apple logo, restore it with Legacy iOS Kit. This erases the device.

deviceDisconnected.title: Device disconnected
deviceDisconnected.body: The device dropped off the bus during the flow.
recovery: Reconnect the cable.
Retry once the device has been identified again.

verificationFailed.title: Jailbreak verification failed
verificationFailed.body: The device rebooted, but Cydia or SSH was not found. The untether may not have installed correctly.
recovery: Make sure the device has fully booted and is unlocked.
Run the readiness check again; if it is still not jailbroken, run the flow again.

deviceChanged.title: Device or firmware changed
deviceChanged.body: The device identity, firmware or ramdisk does not match the authorized plan. Preparation stopped.
recovery: Return the original device to normal mode, reconnect it and generate a new plan.

alreadyJailbroken.title: Device is already jailbroken
alreadyJailbroken.body: An existing jailbreak was detected before installation. No jailbreak packages were installed.
recovery: Hold Power and Home to reboot, then recheck readiness.

rebootTimeout.title: Reboot timed out
rebootTimeout.body: The original device did not return to a verifiable normal mode in time. Installation has not been confirmed.
recovery: Keep the cable connected, let the device finish booting, unlock it, then recheck.

checksumMismatch.title: Resource verification failed
checksumMismatch.body: A resource size or SHA-256 does not match the pinned manifest. The device was not modified.
recovery: Export the log and check cached resources, then download them again.

transferFailed.title: Payload transfer failed
transferFailed.body: An installation file could not be sent. Earlier steps may already have modified the system.
recovery: Keep the device connected, export the log and check its boot state before deciding on recovery.

usbReasons.timeoutOrCancelled: USB control transfer timed out or was cancelled
usbReasons.reconnectTimeout: Timed out waiting for the device to return
usbReasons.notPwned: Device still has no pwned DFU marker
usbReasons.missingComponent: A required boot image component is missing
